heuristics.name: antonym-pair
heuristics.description: When two options are opposites, pick one of the pair (sentence likely turns on that axis)

heuristics.name: pair-coherence
heuristics.description: For two-blank items, pick the pair whose words form a natural or contrastive collocation

heuristics.name: odd-one-out
heuristics.description: Pick the option whose sense or polarity differs from the other three

heuristics.name: synonym-cluster-elimination
heuristics.description: Two or more near-synonyms cannot be uniquely keyed; pick from the remainder

heuristics.name: rare-word
heuristics.description: Pick the most sophisticated/rare word as the likely hard-item key

heuristics.name: duplicate-first-word
heuristics.description: When two pairs share a first word, the key is likely one of them; pick the more coherent

notes: Options-only; most signal came from antonym pairs and near-synonym clusters. reject_certain only where three options are synonyms.
